name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Whitestown IN

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed the large cross-dock DC building at 5490 Industrial Ct, Whitestown (AllPoints at Anson logistics park, NW of Indianapolis just W of I-65). LoopNet lists 628,206 SF, 36-ft clear, 257 parking spaces, 76 dock doors. Roster ROOFTOP geocode landed on the building's SW corner; locked center moved to the building centroid (~39.96345, -86.38215).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint structure visible at the NW or SE truck-yard driveway entrances; both are open paved approaches off the perimeter park road. Marked false; listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth visible at any truck-yard entrance. A small orange structure near the NW dock face appears to be a maintenance/utility unit, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Building is a cross-dock layout with two separate dock banks on opposite long faces (NW face and SE face), each with its own truck yard — consistent with separated shipping vs receiving.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: LoopNet specifies 76 dock doors; satellite shows two long banks of doors with trailers backed in on the NW and SE faces, consistent with that figure.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Both the NW and SE truck yards are very large paved lots holding many parked trailers; combined drop capacity is well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two truck-yard access driveways observed (NW yard and SE yard); each connects directly to the perimeter park road. Counted as 2; uncertain whether one is gated or controlled.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Both truck yards have large unused paved width and wide driveway aprons; ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Whitestown sits in the Indianapolis metro's dense industrial logistics fabric (AllPoints at Anson park, surrounded by mega-DCs and I-65 interchange retail) — classified Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
